question: Identify the top 10 Citibike stations by highest proportion of group rides, defined as trips starting and ending at the same station where multiple riders departed/arrived within the same 2-minute time window. Calculate the proportion as the number of trips that are part of a group divided by the total number of trips ending at that station.
sql:
WITH same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    end_station_id,
    starttime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
trip_with_window AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    end_station_id,
    starttime,
    DIV(UNIX_SECONDS(starttime), 120) AS window_bucket
  FROM same_station_trips
),
group_windows AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    window_bucket,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM trip_with_window
  GROUP BY start_station_id, window_bucket
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
is_group AS (
  SELECT 
    tw.start_station_id,
    tw.end_station_id,
    tw.starttime,
    CASE WHEN gw.start_station_id IS NOT NULL AND gw.window_bucket = tw.window_bucket THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_group_ride
  FROM trip_with_window tw
  LEFT JOIN group_windows gw 
    ON tw.start_station_id = gw.start_station_id 
    AND tw.window_bucket = gw.window_bucket
),
total_end_station AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
),
station_proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    ig.end_station_id,
    SUM(ig.is_group_ride) as group_rides,
    te.total_trips,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(ig.is_group_ride), te.total_trips) as proportion
  FROM is_group ig
  JOIN total_end_station te ON ig.end_station_id = te.end_station_id
  GROUP BY ig.end_station_id, te.total_trips
),
station_names AS (
  SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
),
final_names AS (
  SELECT end_station_id, end_station_name
  FROM station_names
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
  sp.end_station_id,
  fn.end_station_name as station_name,
  sp.group_rides,
  sp.total_trips,
  sp.proportion
FROM station_proportions sp
JOIN final_names fn ON sp.end_station_id = fn.end_station_id
ORDER BY sp.proportion DESC
LIMIT 10
